items: `dataset` reads `data-...` attributes as text values. Convert a numeric value explicitly before doing arithmetic.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: The console shows 45. Number changes the text 40 into a number before adding 5.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Dataset values are strings. Without Number, adding 5 to "40" would join text instead of adding numbers.
